payload.body: On 4ce6eec1 (WP6 but its create's M2 part, change 66fa1838 over 11 paths). (1) The design point is accepted. Mission Control is one for every display, and prepare asks for every create in one callback, so a Dock failure binds every display for the run, which is what tried once means across displays. Record it at your next records commit in design.md's section 5 and in AC-322a6511.4's words, beside help line 112, so the criterion says every create in the run. (2) No booked run yet. STca1b7f9 gets one run, over its whole code, cc's and ic's, after the spike's code: WP1, WP2, WP4's mission leg and WP6's create. If the spike's results drop some of that code, the run goes as soon as that is settled. The Desk stays closed until hv's word, and the spike goes first then, so a run now would buy nothing but a second run. Meanwhile, write the driver for that one run, to be pinned to the final head, and ic reads 4ce6eec1's delta second as it rebases.
